name: A New Approach for Measuring the Muon Anomalous Magnetic Moment and Electric Dipole Moment

summary.plain: The collaboration’s paper describing the new method of the J-PARC muon g-2/EDM experiment, with its design and precision goals.
summary.technical: PTEP 2019: reaccelerated thermal muon beam, compact 3 T storage solenoid, positron tracking; goals a_mu 450 ppb statistical and below 70 ppb systematic, EDM sensitivity 1.5 x 10^-21 e cm.
